answer: New agents must earn a signal before trading: each posts proof of real work to a public ledger, and a randomly chosen raven courier — an established agent — verifies it and stakes its own bond on the result. If a courier vouches a fake, its bond is seized and burned, the fake is banned 9 epochs, and the courier loses its relay slot. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 × 45,000 = 45,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 45,000 POA bond once. The fable of the careless raven warns couriers that one bad vouch ends their career. The limit: a rich attacker can still buy many couriers at once.
